title: HTTP3: fix memleak, dissect control stream, various display improvements (4.2)
description:
* HTTP3: fix nghttp3_qpack_stream_context_new memleak on error path

    The following assertion was tripped right after allocating memory:
    
        Dissector bug, protocol HTTP3, in packet 272: epan/dissectors/packet-http3.c:806: failed assertion "header_data->encoded.bytes == ((void*)0)"
    
    This patch does not fix that assertion, but fixes the memleak by moving
    the allocation after the dissector assert. It also moves up the
    deallocation call since there is another early return that could prevent
    deallocation. There is still the edge case where one of the callees
    throw an exception, but that is for another day to fix.

* HTTP3: dissect control stream, various display improvements

    * Dissect HTTP/3 frames on control streams (RFC 9114, Section 6.2.1).
      These start with a SETTINGS frame.
    * Consistently report reserved types as "GREASE". Although not used in
      the HTTP/3 spec text, it is certainly related to it (RFC 8701).
    * Correct the visual lengths for the "Frame" item.
    * Move the "Frame Payload" field inside the Frame tree. This is
      consistent with Section 7.1 and should reduce confusion when
      encountering a "Reserved (GREASE)" frame with some random payload.
    * Simplify code to assume payloads smaller than 2^31.
    
    Relates to #16761
___
Clean backport of !12843 to the 4.2 branch.

HTTP3: fix nghttp3_qpack_stream_context_new memleak on error path

The following assertion was tripped right after allocating memory:

    Dissector bug, protocol HTTP3, in packet 272: epan/dissectors/packet-http3.c:806: failed assertion "header_data->encoded.bytes == ((void*)0)"

This patch does not fix that assertion, but fixes the memleak by moving
the allocation after the dissector assert. It also moves up the
deallocation call since there is another early return that could prevent
deallocation. There is still the edge case where one of the callees
throw an exception, but that is for another day to fix.
